facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports mandatory SIM and eSIM registration in Burundi began in mid-June 2026, requiring registrants to present legible, up-to-date identification documents at a registration point, with ARCT interconnecting operators and state bodies for real-time monitoring of registration and user identity.
Connecting Africa reports ARCT's director general said 70% of SIM cards had been registered, over three months after the campaign began; no figure for checks against the national ID is given.

systems.owner: ARCT; Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy

note: The usage fact has no event date beyond the document's published date of 2026-10-02.
